topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Oh, I just found out the sweetest, most unexpected thing today, and I don’t even know where to begin. My kid’s got the same teacher I had back in the day. Miss Thompson, the one with the gentle voice and the way of making everything make sense. It’s like a piece of my past, a comfort blanket almost, woven into my child’s life now. I remember her stories, her smile, how safe her classroom felt. It’s a bittersweet thing to think about, all the memories flooding back. I wish I could just step back in time, maybe sit in the corner and watch over them both, but time doesn’t work that way, does it? Still, it’s nice, this little thread connecting us, tying my heart to theirs in a way that feels... precious.
